title: Let searching speak its real hunger
summary: Let better company and honest stillness teach the wandering mind how to settle. Let this stay near the next choice: let this stay with you: bring your searching to holy company and let it cool there.
takeaway: Return the mind to better company before it scatters again.
lifeApplication: Before adding another plan, give the restless heart one quiet place to stay.

source.shortMeaning: Searching clears when it admits hunger for Darshan and stops roaming alone.
source.lifeApplication: When you start hunting everywhere, name the Darshan you seek and bring it to company.
